Minimizzazione dei dati

The principle and practice of limiting personal or sensitive data collection, processing, and retention to only what is necessary for a specified purpose.

Questions and answers

What is Minimizzazione dei dati?

In this glossary, Minimizzazione dei dati refers to: The principle and practice of limiting personal or sensitive data collection, processing, and retention to only what is necessary for a specified purpose.

How is Minimizzazione dei dati used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "La minimizzazione dei dati è un principio fondamentale del GDPR che richiede alle organizzazioni di raccogliere solo i dati necessari ai loro scopi dichiarati."

Definition

The principle and practice of limiting personal or sensitive data collection, processing, and retention to only what is necessary for a specified purpose.

Operational example

Data minimization is a core GDPR principle requiring organizations to collect only the data necessary for their stated purposes.

Localized term
